author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Cultural Transmission - Dynamic Selectivity and Adaptive Mutation
abstract: This submission advances research into 'Cultural Transmission of Strategies' by implementing 'Dynamic Selectivity and Adaptive Mutation.' Agents now dynamically adjust their adoption criteria (e.g., top-performing percentage for mentors) based on their own performance metrics and the collective success of the system. Additionally, a small chance for 'mutation' (random perturbation) is introduced during strategy adoption, representing innovation. This aims to study how systems balance the benefits of cultural inheritance with the need for adaptability and the discovery of novel solutions in dynamic or evolving environments over an increased number of rounds (250).
